\newcommand{\PredictionsAppendix}{%
\pageunit{Conditional predictions: composition limits}{app:predictions}{%
All twenty IDs below retain their Stage A meaning. Every additive comparison
requires ASM-001; linear predictions require ASM-003 where stated. Reference
models and perturbations belong to the same applied-model space, not accepted
models by implication. Missing premises mean the affected claim is unavailable.
These are conditional deductions, not experiments or selected defaults.
\Pred{001}{Zero applied feedback}{%
If $\ma=0$ and $\Pi_k(0)=B_k(0)=0$ on otherwise identical compatible state,
support, reference/gauge/null-space state, $z_k=F_k(\yin)$. Zero candidate or
accepted model does not imply zero applied model; coordinate zero or an
unavailable mode is not an observed zero.}{%
Substitute the applied zero into Equation~\ref{eq:composition}. Offsets in
non-zero-preserving maps defeat this reduction even for zero applied values.}
\Pred{002}{Identity residual procedure}{%
If $F_k$ is identity on compatible $Y_k=Z_k$, $\Pi_k=B_k$ on the applied
operand, and support, reference/gauge/null-space arithmetic agree, $z_k=\yin$
in that exact space. No unavailable observational mode is restored and no
accepted/applied equality is assumed.}{%
Removal and rejoin cancel as equal compatible contributions. A missing premise
blocks cancellation rather than supplying an alignment or missing measurement.}
\Pred{003}{Zero net linear model path}{%
Under complete fixed linearity and $B_k=A_k\circ\Pi_k$ on $M_k$,
$D_k=0$ and $z_k=A_k\yin$, independent of applied model under those conditions.}{%
The two maps in the definition of $D_k$ are equal. State or rule changes are
outside the fixed-operator premise.}
\Pred{004}{Perfect applied operand}{%
If $\yin=\Pi_k(m_{\rm ref}^{\ap})$, $\ma=m_{\rm ref}^{\ap}$ and $F_k$
is zero-preserving in the declared reference/gauge, $z_k=B_k(m_{\rm ref}^{\ap})$.
A perfect accepted model alone is insufficient.}{%
Compatible subtraction makes $\rho_k=0$. Nonidentity rejoin proves neither
true sky nor unit response; content in an unavailable additive mode remains
\texttt{model\_or\_prior\_supported}.}
\src{REQUIRED\_CONDITIONAL\_PREDICTIONS 001--004; RESPONSE\_AND\_UNCERTAINTY\_FAMILIES.}
}
\pageunit{Conditional predictions: error, procedure and support}{app:predictions-b}{%
\Pred{005}{Applied-model error}{%
Under complete fixed linearity, the same input/operators and
$\ma=m_{\rm ref}^{\ap}+\delta_m^{\ap}$, the model-induced difference from the
same procedure at $m_{\rm ref}^{\ap}$ is $D_k\delta_m^{\ap}$. Its conditional
mean is that bias component, not all sky bias or untransformed accepted error.}{%
Subtract the two instances of Equation~\ref{eq:linear}; the identical input
term cancels. The difference belongs to the declared compatible result space.}
\Pred{006}{Recomputed versus frozen PTC component}{%
Inherited ordinary fixed-subspace/recomputed-coefficient application and the
separately named frozen-component subtraction have different rules/responses.
Incidental equality does not make them interchangeable. One unchanged
recomputation method retains identity across new coefficient/application states.}{%
The quoted coefficient rule acts on its current centered input; the frozen
subtraction holds its removed numerical component fixed and has identity
input derivative. The distinct procedures are explicit in Appendix~\ref{app:ptc}.}
\Pred{007}{Model-supported content}{%
If a method permits model-only output or a declared model contribution in an
upstream unavailable additive mode, that content is
\texttt{model\_or\_prior\_supported}, not observed, recovered from data,
acquired exposure or unit-response truth.}{%
Its declared information source is the model/prior. Rejoin and a reference/gauge
choice add no measurement authority; permission for model-only output is itself required.}
\Pred{008}{Support or additive incompatibility}{%
For unequal path support or incompatible reference/gauge/null-space facts,
use a permitted support class only with full declared additive compatibility;
otherwise the affected composition is unavailable.}{%
A partial or incompatible map has no licensed sum on that domain. No implicit
fill, renormalization, offset or gauge alignment repairs the missing premise.}
\src{REQUIRED\_CONDITIONAL\_PREDICTIONS 005--008; SUPPORT\_INFORMATION\_ORIGIN; PTC\_APPLICATION\_REFERENCE.}
}
\pageunit{Conditional predictions: response and uncertainty}{app:predictions-c}{%
\Pred{009}{Data-dependent procedure}{%
When construction, acceptance, application or consequential state depends on
data, RF-03 includes one iteration with prior state fixed; RF-04 propagates
fixed-sequence dependence; RF-05 includes stop/resource/selection dependence;
RF-07 composes the full FRUIT-only parent-domain query.}{%
Each boundary encloses different causal operations. Omitting an enclosed
dependence answers another query. These are neither RF-01/RF-02 aliases nor
independent duplicates of their components.}
\Pred{010}{Crossing a query boundary}{%
If a query crosses threshold, support, branch, state or terminal-selection
boundaries, a derivative may be unavailable; retain the typed discontinuity
or transition. A finite difference needs its own convention and compatible
reference/gauge/null-space comparison.}{%
A fixed-branch derivative does not describe a changed procedure branch. If
comparison or derivative existence fails, that requested response is unavailable.}
\Pred{011}{Joint conditional covariance}{%
Under complete fixed linearity and the exact joint covariance/conditioning
premises for $(\yin,\ma)$, all four terms of Equation~\ref{eq:covariance},
including both cross terms, are required unless exact authority establishes
an omission. Candidate/accepted covariance needs transformation.}{%
Expanding the covariance of the linear sum yields both mixed products.
Conditioning on a fixed gauge cannot turn an unavailable mode into a measured
zero-uncertainty mode or discard dependence from another target.}
\Pred{012}{Reused information}{%
Iterations reusing a parent or shared model/reference information do not
become independent measurements and imply no
$1/\sqrt{\text{iteration count}}$ uncertainty scaling.}{%
Reusing information preserves ancestry and shared dependence. Iteration count
supplies no independent-measurement population or scaling premise.}
\src{REQUIRED\_CONDITIONAL\_PREDICTIONS 009--012; RESPONSE\_AND\_UNCERTAINTY\_FAMILIES.}
}
\pageunit{Conditional predictions: continuation and selection}{app:predictions-d}{%
\Pred{013}{Continuation equality}{%
After completion of the iteration with absolute zero-based index $N$, if
$S_{N+1}$ is continuation-sufficient and future controls and method/profile
agree, continuation begins at absolute index $N+1$ from $S_{N+1}$ and agrees
with uninterrupted execution, including reference/gauge/null-space state.
$N$ is an index, not a count.}{%
Both continuations consume the same complete scientific state under the same
future controls. An omitted consequential fact defeats the premise. This
criterion performs no replay or numerical sufficiency check.}
\Pred{014}{Restart and relearning}{%
Restart has a new lineage. Relearning under unchanged rules produces distinct
state/application generations and may belong to exact continuation. Changing
the learning rule requires a new method identity.}{%
Lineage records the new initialization; state generation records an unchanged
rule's new realization. Neither identity aliases the method's defining rules.}
\Pred{015}{Resource limit}{%
Reaching an iteration/resource maximum establishes its resource/stop state,
not convergence or adequacy.}{%
Resource accounting and the declared convergence proposition are separate
facts. Exhaustion alone supplies none of the metric, persistence or adequacy premises.}
\Pred{016}{Terminal identity}{%
If the rule selects the completed iteration of absolute zero-based index $N$,
the separate immutable record retains selected identity, complete candidate
population, rule/generation, convergence/stop/resource facts, causes, terminal
response/uncertainty, continuation/terminality and use-status references or
permitted unavailable statuses.}{%
Selection is a relation to an already completed bundle. Mutating, relabeling
or replacing that bundle destroys the distinction required by the premise.
Missing hard selection dependencies block the claim.}
\src{REQUIRED\_CONDITIONAL\_PREDICTIONS 013--016; ITERATION\_STATE\_LIFECYCLE.}
}
\pageunit{Conditional predictions: grouping and authority}{app:predictions-e}{%
\Pred{017}{Grouping does not commute by implication}{%
Observation-local, coadd-level and jointly learned groupings do not imply
$\mathrm{FRUIT}(\mathrm{Coadd}(y_o))=\mathrm{Coadd}(\mathrm{FRUIT}(y_o))$.
Any commutation needs exact compatible operators, learning and support premises.}{%
Different grouping may change shared learning, state, support and dependence.
This states absence of an implied equivalence, not universal inequality or
a numerical coaddition rule. Here $y_o$ denotes only the explicitly compared
observation inputs of this conditional statement.}
\Pred{018}{Distinct NOI rules}{%
Fixed-state NOI and per-realization relearning rules require separate
method/ensemble identities and cannot share one ensemble here. Members under
an unchanged rule have distinct realized states, not a new method each.}{%
Changing the rule changes which variations the ensemble includes. New values
under one rule change realization identity. No mixing/pooling authority is supplied.}

Without a complete exact owner-approved
\texttt{FRUIT-\allowbreak FEEDBACK-\allowbreak METHOD/\allowbreak <method-\allowbreak name>@<revision>} record, no numerical
FRUIT route or result is admitted. Creating the v0.1 family or authoring/freezing
the conditional core does not approve a method-specific identity.}{%
Authority C is independent of A/B and of document completion. Even an approved
method still needs its required upstream numerical authority. Current numerical
status remains \unavail.}
\Pred{020}{Local completeness and consumer fitness}{%
A bundle satisfying universal minimum structure/hard dependencies and its
exact method's requirements does not establish Pointing, OOF, source/catalogue
admission or production fitness. An absent downstream profile does not erase
permitted local completeness; a method cannot waive core roles to claim it.}{%
The consumer owns its named-use admission. Local completion and downstream
fitness are different propositions with separate evidence and authority.
No actual numerical completed bundle is claimed in this draft.}
\src{REQUIRED\_CONDITIONAL\_PREDICTIONS 017--020; FRUIT\_FEEDBACK\_METHOD\_REQUIRED\_RECORD; BOUNDARIES\_AND\_CONVENTIONS.}
